nodes.name: window.rs
nodes.summary: Core Window DOM implementation with 245+ methods covering lifecycle, layout/reflow, navigation, alerts, timers, scrolling, user activation, screenshot readiness, XR sessions, and webdriver integration. The primary script-side representation of a browsing context.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust DOM struct with extensive use of SpiderMonkey JSAPI bindings, DomRefCell for interior mutability, and cross-beam channels for IPC with the constellation process.
